# onetoeight: The Eight Essentials (Universal edition)

> A free, practical guide for young people aged 13 to 23, building eight foundations that hold.

The Universal edition is a secular guide, written for every background, belief and tradition. Every page carries spoken-word audio, and the guide includes discussion questions and activities for youth groups, schools and community settings. Free to read and adapt.

## The eight essentials

- [The ability to sit in silence](https://onetoeight.org/guide/universal/essential-one-universal.html): Make room to notice before adding more input.
- [Your body is a home](https://onetoeight.org/guide/universal/essential-two-universal.html): Care for the body you actually have.
- [Useful skills for real life](https://onetoeight.org/guide/universal/essential-three-universal.html): Feed yourself, fix safely, make things and understand money.
- [Digital self-defence](https://onetoeight.org/guide/universal/essential-four-universal.html): Protect your attention, privacy, accounts and identity.
- [Real community](https://onetoeight.org/guide/universal/essential-five-universal.html): Build belonging without turning friendship into a score.
- [Knowledge you can carry](https://onetoeight.org/guide/universal/essential-six-universal.html): Use the internet without outsourcing your mind.
- [Make room for the outside](https://onetoeight.org/guide/universal/essential-seven-universal.html): Go gently, notice more and adapt nature to your life.
- [Test what you believe](https://onetoeight.org/guide/universal/essential-eight-universal.html): Examine convictions and stay open to evidence.

## More in the guide

- [Reading & Resources](https://onetoeight.org/guide/universal/reading-resources.html): Free, well-chosen next steps, one for each essential. Scan or tap to open each link.
- [Activities](https://onetoeight.org/guide/universal/activities.html): Hands-on things to try, one category for each essential. Pick one and do it this week.
- [Discussion questions](https://onetoeight.org/guide/universal/discussion-questions.html): Ready-to-run conversations for youth groups, schools and community settings.

## Optional

- [Start here](https://onetoeight.org/guide/universal/index.html): the introduction, why roots matter, and the full contents.
- [Essential One in Indonesian](https://onetoeight.org/guide/universal/essential-one-universal-id.html), [Tagalog](https://onetoeight.org/guide/universal/essential-one-universal-tl.html) and [Vietnamese](https://onetoeight.org/guide/universal/essential-one-universal-vi.html): translated editions of the first essential.

## Notes

- Free to read and share. No account required once you have the link.
- The guide is written for ages 13 to 23 and avoids fear-based framing.
- Each essential page ends with practical "do this this week" challenges.
